title: Meet 16-year-old Pennsylvania student who opened his second restaurant while still in high school
summary_full: Sixteen-year-old Gage Klein is already running his second restaurant in Pennsylvania while continuing high school. He recently opened Driftwood at the Fairgrounds in West York, after launching his first restaurant, Driftwood at the Lake, more than a year ago. With his father Kris helping with the business, Klein plans to attend culinary school after graduation and hopes to open more restaurants in the future.
